conclusion: SDK 4 empty buffer-clear branch preserves stale pre-seek metrics above scheduling target; with no later progress/timeupdate event, loading cannot resume. Native SDK 4 reproduces on both engines; synthetic metric refresh and one-line diagnostic backport restore playback. SDK 5 includes the refresh and passes the held-pause native cases.
exclusions: No runtime, declaration, dependency or SDK upgrade shipped
No synthetic timeupdate in production or default validation
Diagnostic patched SDK is not official SDK acceptance
SDK 4 risk stays open until compatible mitigation or reviewed release disposition
One intermediate syntax error prevented test discovery; original log retained
No complete browser matrix or full CI claimed for this diagnostic-only change
